Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother,” incorrectly moving one generation up the paternal line and naming Louis XV’s mother (Marie Adélaïde of Savoy) instead of the father’s mother (Marie Leszczyńska). This confusion arose after landing on a disambiguation page and failing to verify the specific Louis (1729–1765), leading to the erroneous substitution of the paternal great-grandmother for the paternal grandmother.
